_comment: Kernel determinism gate allowlist. See scripts/check-kernel-determinism.mjs for gate logic.

transcendentals._comment: Files permitted to call engine-approximated transcendental Math functions (Math.exp/log/sin/cos/tan/pow/atan/asin/acos/sinh/cosh/tanh/cbrt/expm1/log1p/log2/log10/atan2/hypot). These are implementation-defined by libm (ECMA-262 Annex B). Outputs may differ across JS engines for irrational inputs. The §17/§18 guest (QuickJS-ng, ImageID a1a0bc89) is empirically identical to V8 for the numeric ranges in these kernels — see cross-engine-parity.yml. DOWNWARD RATCHET: removing a file is always safe; adding a file requires a deliberate human decision.

hard_ban_baseline._comment: Pre-existing hard-ban violations that existed before this gate was introduced (2026-07-02). Each entry WARNS but does not fail the gate. DOWNWARD RATCHET ONLY: once the underlying code is fixed, remove the entry. Adding new entries requires a deliberate decision and a note explaining why immediate remediation is impractical.

entries.note: Fallback when pp.validate_at_unix is not provided: Math.floor(Date.now() / 1000). Makes kernel non-deterministic when called without a timestamp. Fix: remove fallback, require pp.validate_at_unix, or accept null result when timestamp missing.

NFD normalization for fuzzy IBAN/name matching: .normalize('NFD').replace(...). ICU-dependent; may differ in QuickJS guest. Fix: port to a pure-JS Unicode NFC/NFD table or restrict the character range to ASCII-safe decompositions.

Locale-default sort of doc_type strings: [...docs].sort((a,b) => a.localeCompare(b)). For ASCII-only doc_type values this is stable, but localeCompare without a locale arg is technically ICU-dependent. Fix: use explicit locale arg (a.localeCompare(b,'en-US')) or a simple a > b ? 1 : -1 comparator.
